title: Clear stale test-run session activity after invalidation followed by a state diff
outcome: A test-run activity invalidation followed by a cumulative state diff cannot leave a session's running/notify badge or Working classification stale; authoritative full state also repairs activity at an equal overview version without refetching readers.
acceptance: The existing state-diff touched-key owner includes session activity affected by a test-run invalidation, so a zero-activity base, intermediate running invalidation and final zero-activity cut clear the client's activity.
Full-state adoption repairs the activity map at an equal server/overview version while preserving the view revision token; controlled regressions cover delta-then-cut and full-state repair.
